name: review-tab-marketplace
description: Marketplace for the review-tab plugin — batch diff review for Claude Code with per-hunk keep/restore and feedback loop.

plugins.name: review-tab
plugins.description: After Claude edits your code, a review page opens in your browser showing every change it made. You go through each change and decide to keep it or undo it, and you can leave a note explaining why. If you undo something, Claude reads your note the next time you send a message in that session, so it knows what you didn't want.
